name: Warren County, NJ
findings: Warren County has 383 nonprofit organizations. 182 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 141 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warren County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 25 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
